rules.detail: 한 주문 items 안에 같은 order_item_id

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.orders WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.payments WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.refunds WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

rules.description: 환불이 가리키는 상품 행이 없다 (환불이 주문보다 먼저 와도 격리하지 않으므로 경고)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {silver}.refunds r LEFT ANTI JOIN {silver}.order_items i ON r.channel = i.channel AND r.order_item_id = i.order_item_id WHERE r.received_at >= {since}

rules.description: 격리 행이 같은 Bronze 위치의 원본과 다르다 (원본 보존)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {silver}.quarantine q LEFT ANTI JOIN {bronze}.events b ON q.eh_partition = b.eh_partition AND q.eh_offset = b.eh_offset AND q.channel <=> b.channel AND q.payload <=> b.payload WHERE q.ingested_at >= {since}

rules.description: order_items의 (channel, order_item_id) 중복 (시각 컬럼이 없어 전수 확인)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_item_id FROM {silver}.order_items GROUP BY channel, order_item_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_item_id FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item GROUP BY channel, order_item_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, refund_id FROM {gold}.fact_refund GROUP BY channel, refund_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id WHERE f.product_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, event_id FROM {silver}.order_cancellations WHERE received_at >= {since} GROUP BY channel, event_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

rules.description: 결제 성공 금액이 주문 상품 결제금액 합 + 배송비와 다르다
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {silver}.payments p JOIN {silver}.orders o ON p.channel = o.channel AND p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN (SELECT channel, order_id, SUM(unit_price * quantity - item_discount) AS items_total FROM {silver}.order_items GROUP BY channel, order_id) i ON o.channel = i.channel AND o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND p.payment_amount <> i.items_total + o.shipping_fee

rules.description: Fact에 있는 주문의 성공 결제금액이 상품 결제금액 합 + 배송비와 다르다
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_id, SUM(item_paid_amount) AS items_total FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item GROUP BY channel, order_id) g JOIN {silver}.orders o ON o.channel = g.channel AND o.order_id = g.order_id JOIN {silver}.payments p ON p.channel = g.channel AND p.order_id = g.order_id AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' WHERE p.payment_amount <> g.items_total + o.shipping_fee

rules.description: 배송비 규칙 위반 (상품 결제금액 합 2만 원 이상 0원, 미만 4,000원)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM (SELECT channel, order_id, SUM(item_paid_amount) AS items_total FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item GROUP BY channel, order_id) g JOIN {silver}.orders o ON o.channel = g.channel AND o.order_id = g.order_id JOIN {silver}.payments p ON p.channel = g.channel AND p.order_id = g.order_id AND p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' WHERE o.shipping_fee <> CASE WHEN g.items_total >= 20000 THEN 0 ELSE 4000 END

rules.description: fact_refund 환불금액 합과 fact_sales_item 환불금액 합이 다르다 (다르면 1)
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM {gold}.fact_refund) = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS violations

rules.description: fact_refund 환불수량 합과 fact_sales_item 환불수량 합이 다르다 (다르면 1)
rules.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_quantity), 0) FROM {gold}.fact_refund) = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_quantity), 0) FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS violations
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_channel d ON f.channel = d.channel WHERE f.channel IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id WHERE f.product_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_sales_item f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_payment_method d ON f.payment_method = d.payment_method WHERE f.payment_method IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_refund f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_channel d ON f.channel = d.channel WHERE f.channel IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_refund f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_product d ON f.product_id = d.product_id WHERE f.product_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS violations FROM {gold}.fact_refund f LEFT ANTI JOIN {gold}.dim_refund_profile d ON f.refund_profile_key = d.refund_profile_key WHERE f.refund_profile_key IS NOT NULL
